naslov: Silence Is No Excuse – Let Us Protect Rogozna

segmenti.tekst: إن الحمد لله نحمده ونستعينه ونستغفره

ونعوذ بالله من شرور أنفسنا ومن سيئات أعمالنا، من يهده الله فلا مضل له ومن يضلل فلا هادي له، وأشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، وأشهد أن محمدا عبده ورسوله، أرسله الله بالحق بشيرا ونذيرا وسراجا منيرا، لينذر من كان حيا ويحق القول على الكافرين، صلى الله تعالى عليه وعلى آله الطيبين الطاهرين وأصحابه الكرام الهداة المهتدين

وَسَلَّمَ تَسْلِيمًا كَثِيرًا إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ. قال الله في كتابه الكريم: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهِ وَلَا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَأَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ. أَمَّا بَعْدُ. Praise belongs to Allah alone, the Exalted, subhanahu wa ta'ala, the Lord of all the worlds, the Lord of the Day of Judgement, the Lord of jinn and mankind. May blessings and peace be upon His Messenger, the beloved Muhammad, sallallahu alayhi wa sallam (peace be upon him), upon his family, upon his companions, and upon all those who follow the path,

the path of the Qur'an, the path of the Sunnah of Muhammad, sallallahu alayhi wa sallam. Dear brothers, respected members of the congregation, in this world full of injustice and oppression, a large number of people think that they are justified by their silence and that, as long as they do not speak falsehood, they bear no responsibility and no sin.

What is wrong? That is a wrong opinion. Describing the Jews, Allah, subhanahu wa ta'ala, says in the Qur'an: "Samma'una lil-kadhibi akkaluna lis-suht" – they listened to lies and devoured what is forbidden, what is haram.

The Qur'anic verse clearly indicates that by their silence they approved of falsehood. Why? Because of some worldly benefit, because of some short-lived benefit, whether it be position, wealth and so on.

Unfortunately, this practice exists even today. That a person, because of a worldly benefit, stays silent about something that is happening in the community, some injustice or something more than that. Why? Because of a worldly benefit.

So that they don't close down my shop, so that they don't fire me, so that I don't offend anyone, and so on, and so on. And so the silence of people in a time, in a time of oppression and injustice, when that injustice is obvious – the example of the one who stays silent then is the example of the one, it is the same example as the one who speaks falsehood.
And the same sin, especially for people who have influence in the community, in society. My dear brothers, our beloved city, Pazar, is facing one, perhaps the greatest challenge of recent decades.

And that challenge is mining on Mount Rogozna. It is mining on Mount Rogozna. This kind of mining, dear brothers, brings with it great consequences, and those consequences are visible all over the world.
In Romania, in the year 2000, a large amount of water mixed with the chemical cyanide spilled out – cyanide dissolves, that is, it melts the gold and separates it from the ore.

So if that chemical comes into contact with water, the ecosystem falls apart. A great ecological disaster occurs, like the one that happened then in Romania in 2000, in the town, that is, in the city of Baia Mare.

We also have examples in Ghana, in Canada, in British Columbia, in many places, in Peru. We have all become convinced of the "good intentions" of those huge companies that come looking for our ores, and whoever is not convinced can easily go to our Mount Rogozna to see how they have done it, in what way they have done it.
Over two hundred boreholes, improper disposal of waste – they are literally destroying our untouched, untouched nature.

That is why, dear brothers, we must by no means stay silent about this injustice. Because if we stay silent about this injustice, about what is happening to us, neither will that job of yours benefit you, nor will this one benefit me.

We will literally all have to move away from these lands. So silence will bring us no benefit. Not only regarding Rogozna, but also the other things that are happening in our city while we stay silent and watch mutely.

He says: "It's not my business to get involved, it's not my business" – it is nobody's business, and people carry out deals from which they gain personal benefit, while the community suffers. So it is haram, a sin, for everyone to stay silent about injustice being committed in society, and we must be united when such things are at stake, so that we do not allow this to be done.
Allah forbids this to us with the words: "And do not kill yourselves." And with moves like these we will kill ourselves, drive ourselves out, and so on, and so on.

I ask Allah, subhanahu wa ta'ala, that we be united, that we be like one hand, that we not allow others to do us injustice, that we be true believers, that we be good servants of Allah, that we protect ourselves and our future generations, that we have something to leave them, that we provide something for them, that we worship Allah, subhanahu wa ta'ala, as He has commanded us. Amin, ya Rabbal-'alamin. Barakallahu li wa lakum fil-Qur'anil-'azim, وَنَفَعَنِي وَإِيَّاكُمْ بِمَا فِيهِ مِنَ الْآيَاتِ وَالذِّكْرِ الْحَكِيمِ
أَقُولُ قَوْلِي هَذَا وَأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ لِي وَلَكُمْ فَاسْتَغْفِرُوهُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
